scripts.dev: concurrently -n panels,race,host -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:panels" "npm run dev:race-track" "npm run dev:host"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix panels && npm run build --prefix race-track && npm run build --prefix host
scripts.test: cd host && npm run test && cd ../panels && npm run test && cd ../race-track && npm run test
scripts.test:coverage: cd host && npm run test:coverage && cd ../panels && npm run test:coverage && cd ../race-track && npm run test:coverage
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -n host,panels,race "cd host && npm run test:watch" "cd panels && npm run test:watch" "cd race-track && npm run test:watch"
